components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main commit action in a form or operational flow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--accent-line); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--accent); color: oklch(12% 0.04 286); font: 600 12px/1.35 var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 200ms ease-out, border-color 200ms ease-out, transform 200ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 88%, white 12%); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet alternative action that stays available without competing with the commit action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--bg-raised); color: var(--text-primary); font: 600 12px/1.35 var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 200ms ease-out, border-color 200ms ease-out, color 200ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--bg-raised) 88%, white 12%); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A compact search field used beside roster filters and sorting.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; min-height: 42px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 240px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 11px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--bg-base) 94%, white 6%); color: var(--text-muted); transition: border-color 200ms ease-out, box-shadow 200ms ease-out; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--primary-line); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--primary-soft); } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; width: 100%; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-primary); font: 400 14px/1.45 var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-search-icon { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 20px; }

components.name: Custom Select Trigger
components.description: The trigger for a keyboard-navigable custom listbox, not a native select.
components.css: .ds-select { display: flex; min-height: 42px; width: 180px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--bg-raised); color: var(--text-primary); font: 600 12px/1.35 var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 200ms ease-out, background 200ms ease-out; } .ds-select:hover, .ds-select[aria-expanded="true"] { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--cyan) 52%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--cyan) 9%, var(--bg-raised)); } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The current section state in the desktop sidebar or mobile drawer.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: grid; min-height: 42px; width: 100%; grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--cyan) 32%, transparent); border-radius: 13px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--cyan) 12%, transparent); color: var(--cyan); text-align: left; font: 600 12px/1.35 var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-active strong { color: var(--text-muted); font: 700 11px/1.2 var(--font-geist-mono), monospace; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Summary Chip
components.description: A compact readout for totals, rota counts and secondary metrics.
components.css: .ds-summary { display: inline-grid; min-width: 68px; gap: 2px; padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 13px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--bg-raised) 82%, transparent); } .ds-summary strong { color: var(--text-primary); font: 700 16px/1 var(--font-geist-mono), monospace; } .ds-summary span { color: var(--text-muted); font: 600 11px/1.35 var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Operator Bar
components.description: Tablet-first sticky surface combining location readouts and roster search.
components.html: 42всегоКазарма 18Госпиталь 3
components.css: .ds-operator { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--bg-base) 94%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.2); } .ds-operator-row { display: flex; min-width: 0; gap: 8px; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 2px; } .ds-summary-accent { border-color: var(--primary-line); background: var(--primary-soft); } .ds-summary-accent strong { color: var(--primary); } .ds-location { display: inline-flex; min-height: 42px; flex: 0 0 auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 13px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--bg-raised) 80%, transparent); color: var(--text-primary); font: 600 12px/1.35 var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-location b { color: var(--cyan); font: 700 14px/1.2 var(--font-geist-mono), monospace; }

narrative.overview: Rashod — спокойный тёмный рабочий интерфейс для контроля и распределения личного состава. Он держит состояние и следующее действие рядом, чтобы оператор мог работать быстро и уверенно на desktop или планшете. Визуальная выразительность строится на точных слоях, семантическом цвете и согласованных controls, а не на игрушечной декоративности.
keyCharacteristics: Deep indigo workspace with restrained orchid accent
Touch-friendly 42px controls and tablet operator bar
Mono readouts for time, counts and aligned values

rules.name: The Operational Accent Rule
rules.body: Orchid and cyan communicate action, focus, selection or state; they are not decorative surface fills.

rules.name: The Calm Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use measured type scale, weight and contrast instead of oversized display typography.

rules.name: The Layered-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Use tonal surfaces and quiet lines before adding a shadow; reserve wide shadows for app-level surfaces.

dos: Do keep tablet controls touch-friendly and preserve visible focus.
Do reuse the shared custom listbox, search/sort and icon vocabulary.
donts: Don't make the interface look игрушечным.
Don't use gradient text, colored side stripes, repeating stripe backgrounds or sketchy illustrations.
Don't turn every ordinary control into a floating glass card.
